topic: UK tender partial win and future strategy
summary_markdown:
A project update was shared regarding the UK tender. Although the full tender was not won, a significant positive outcome was achieved: securing participation in a part of the route tender for the next five years. This partial win is viewed as highly positive and an opportunity to improve the audience measurement platform step-by-step.

The participants acknowledged that while the full project was missed, gaining entry into this specific segment is still considered great news.
decisions: The company secured participation in a part of the UK route tender for five years.
